description: This file defines the main application package 'Coocook' for a web-based recipe and meal planning system using Catalyst framework. It includes configuration, plugin setup, and application initialization.

classes.name: Coocook
classes.description: Main application class for the Coocook web app, extending Catalyst, with configuration and setup for plugins, security, and email templates.

methods.description: Checks if a Perl module is installed by attempting to require it and returning the module name if successful.

methods.name: setup_finalize
